_meta.keys: As genesis_bundles_v6.json: Key n = ML-DSA-65 seed [n]*32, Ed25519 seed [n+100]*32. Holders A,B,C,D = 1,2,3,4; seats 11,12; A's other key 31; recovery key of holder n = n+50; A's signing key after its rotation or recovery 41; A's next recovery key 61; a key no commitment names 71.
_meta.placement: as v6, with further_prev, past (every bundle in the lineage past) and recovery_retired_keys (the signing keys a counted recovery replaced, by holder)
_meta.predecessors: each names an earlier case of this file (every Valid bundle it read is held) or {not_valid: object id}
_meta.spec: CC 2.6.1.11 (A bundle that joins tips; a recovery behind its holder's head), CIRISConstitution rc23 lane d103e60
_meta.verdicts: valid | invalid (token genesis_bundle_malformed, detail = reason) | waiting {rows, prev, further_prev, kids} | nothing (token; detail)

cases.description: The first bundle: A, B and C sign.
C swapped for D; A, B and D sign.
The same change a second later: a second successor of the first bundle.
A rotates to a new key by a roster bundle every holder signs, A under its current key.
A recovers under its recovery key: its genesis signing key is replaced.
A third bundle on swap_1 re-committing B; A and B sign.
The same bundle held with B's and D's statements only.
A join of the two swaps: version 3, prev the lesser object id, the other in further_prev; A and B sign, a strict majority of each predecessor's holders.
The same join with prev and further_prev exchanged: among equal versions prev is the least object id.
The join at version 4 over two version-2 predecessors.
A join of a version-3 and a version-2 bundle: version 4, prev the version-3 one. B's commitment differs from the version-2 predecessor's, so B signs; A and B do.
The same join with prev naming the version-2 predecessor.
A join naming the third bundle and swap_1, which the third extends.
further_prev with no prev.
further_prev as an empty set: absence is its one encoding.
further_prev naming prev again.
further_prev out of set order.
further_prev holding a bare digest, not an object reference.
The join with only its prev held: Waiting on the further predecessor.
The join with only its further predecessor held: Waiting on prev.
The join with neither held: Waiting on both.
The join where the further predecessor is held and not Valid.
A first bundle of the same holders under another family_key_id.
A join naming swap_1 and the first bundle of another lineage: the predecessors carry one family_key_id.

A join of swap_1 (A at its genesis key, B, D) and the rotation (A at its new key, B, C), seating A, B, C and D. A signs under each of its keys and B signs: A and B of swap_1's three, A and B of the rotation's three.
The same join signed by B, C and D: B and D of swap_1's three, B and C of the rotation's three.
The same join signed by A under its genesis key, B and D: all of swap_1's holders, and of the rotation's three only B. A majority of the holders taken together is no count.
The same join with A's statement under a key neither predecessor seats for it, beside B's: the statement is refused alone, and B alone is no majority of either.
The join seating A at its genesis key, which swap_1 still seats and the rotation's branch retired: a join revives nothing.
A join of the two swaps that seats C again; A, B and D sign and C does not.
The same join with C's statement under its record's key.

A join of swap_1 and A's recovery. A's genesis key, which swap_1 still seats, is no voice and A is no live holder of swap_1: its live holders are B and D. A under its recovered key, B and D sign: B and D of swap_1's two, A and B of the recovery's three.
The same join signed by A under its genesis key and its recovered key, B and C. A's statement under the replaced key is refused alone; of swap_1's live holders, B and D, only B signs.
The same join signed by B, C and D: both counts are met, but A's commitment differs from the one swap_1 carries for it, and A has not signed.
The join keeping for A the commitment swap_1 carries, which the recovery spent.
The join seating A at its genesis key, which the recovery replaced.
A's recovery statement, alone, over a bundle that names two predecessors.
A first bundle with one holder, A.
A recovers.
A second successor: A, under its genesis key, shortens the fuse.
A join of the two, signed by A under its recovered key. The fuse bundle seats A at the key the recovery replaced, so it has no live holder, and nothing is a majority of none.
A's recovery read while the reader holds swap_1, a sibling A signed: the two name one prev, a fork, and the recovery counts.
A's recovery of the first bundle's seat read while the reader holds the third bundle, which A signed and which extends swap_1: the recovery's prev is behind A's own head.
The same with the third bundle counted on B and D: A signed nothing past the recovery's prev but its sibling, and the recovery counts.
A join of the third bundle (B and D counted) and A's recovery, signed by A under its recovered key, B and D.
A's recovery read while the reader holds a join built on it (with the third bundle): a bundle with the recovery in its past never puts it behind.
